messages:
sam: FYI EU-south dedicated pool at 98% GPU utilization, queue depth spiking. Autoscaler tried to spin new workers but hit AZ quota.
priya: Got logs? node-level OOMs or scheduling failures?
sam: posting snippets:
```
2026-03-18T15:01:22Z scheduler: pending pods=42, available gpus=3
kube-scheduler: binding failed: insufficient resources: alpha.nvidia/gpu
```
marco: Looks like the quota for that tenancy is 0 in eu-south for new instance types. Cloud API return 403. I can request quota bump but takes hours.
jen: We should start failing over to hosted to keep SLAs. Can we flip routing flag for that pool to allow hosted fallback?
sam: yes. there's a flag `allow_hosted_fallback=true` per-customer. Right now several enterprise customers have it disabled. If we flip globally we'll route non-strict customers to hosted.
priya: Steps?
sam: 1) set routing override in route-service: `routes.set_priority("eu-south", hosted, weight=1.0)` 2) mark dedicated pool draining: `pool.set_state(dedicated-eus, draining)` 3) scale hosted buffer up `hosted-gpu-pool.scale(4)` 4) update console banner for customers
marco: I'm pushing the hosted buffer scale now. ETA ~2 mins to spin instances.
oncall-bot: Deploy started: hosted-gpu-pool scale +4 by marco (build 4671)
olivia: I'll message CS to prep a short note for impacted customers and to triage any dedicated-only customers that require contracts.
jen: Important: keep dedicated billing accurate. Hosted fallback is billable; we should set a tag `fallback:temporary` so finance can attribute costs.
priya: Also, enable `graceful_prefetch=true` so we can use KV cache warmups on hosted replicas to reduce latency spike.
sam: Done: routing override applied, pool draining. Hosted instances are registering.
oncall-bot: Hosted nodes registered: 4 new gpus, ready
marco: Traffic shifting at router: 30% -> hosted, then 60% after warmup. Observability shows steady p50 increase from 45ms -> 120ms during warmup.
jen: Acceptable for non-enterprise. For customers with `dedicated_only=true` we will return 503 and queue; CS to call out.
olivia: CS update sent to the 3 affected accounts. Two opted into fallback previously; one requires manual approval; sales is on a call.
priya: Cost note: estimated extra hosted spend for the event ~ $6k over next 24h. Tagging in PR for cost ops.
sam: I'll follow up with an infra postmortem tomorrow (brief) with root cause: quota exhaustion + autoscaler retry loop. For now monitoring alerts silenced for alert-fatigue, but keep an eye on errors.
marco: Will open quota request ticket with cloud ops, and schedule a postmortem infra-action to add a cheaper prewarm pool to avoid future emergency quota ops.
jen: Great. thumbs up :thumbsup:
sam: thanks all. ping if anything regresses.
oncall-bot: Thread closed by autoscaler (reason: fallback active).
